{{Quote|Sernpidalian mayo-ketchup and Bimm mustard available upon request.|Dex's Diner menu|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Sernpidalian mayo-ketchup''' was a condiment enjoyed by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] and available in his [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]],<ref name="Menu" /> at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]].<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> A customer could ask for it to be served with any [[slider]] on the menu.<ref name="Menu" /> It shared its name with the planet [[Sernpidal/Legends|Sernpidal]].<ref name="Vector Prime">''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Sernpidalian mayo-ketchup is mentioned in a [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive release, "[[Dining at Dex's]]" by [[Gregory Walker]], which represents the [[in-universe]] menu of Dex's Diner.<ref name="Menu" /> In the [[In-universe|real world]], [[Wikipedia:Ketchup|ketchup]]<ref name="Ketchup">{{WebCite|url=http://www.madehow.com/Volume-2/Ketchup.html|text=Ketchup|author=Audra Avizienis|work=How Products are Made, Volume 2|archivedate=20180612141233}}</ref> and [[Wikipedia:mayonnaise|mayonaisse]], often shortened to "mayo," are popular sauces.<ref name="Mayo">{{WebCite|url=http://www.foodanddrinkeurope.com/Products-Marketing/Mayonnaise-sales-hit-by-egg-price-rise|text=Mayonnaise sales hit by egg price rise|date=2004-04-21|work=Food & Drink Europe|archivedate=20100824183138}}</ref>
